This is a senior-level software engineering role (6+ years) on NVIDIA's GPU cloud infrastructure, focused on the Kubernetes runtime and release automation that installs, upgrades, and validates GPU cluster software. The work spans building controllers and APIs, validation pipelines that gate release decisions, and GPU capacity allocation across test runs, plus bringing new cloud providers and GPU hardware into production. The core stack is Go and Kubernetes — including controller-runtime, CRDs, and reconcilers — with Helm and Argo CD for delivery across public clouds.
